description: This file defines the 'Current' class in the PhpSpreadsheet project's DateTimeExcel calculation namespace. It provides static methods 'today()' and 'now()' to retrieve the current date and current date-time respectively, formatted for spreadsheet use. The class relies on helper functions and external error handling components.

classes.name: Current
classes.description: Provides static methods to retrieve current date and date-time values in spreadsheet-compatible formats.

methods.name: today
methods.description: Returns the current date as a spreadsheet serial number, PHP timestamp, or object depending on context, using PHP's DateTimeImmutable and helper functions.

methods.name: now
methods.description: Returns the current date and time in a format suitable for spreadsheets, similar to Excel's NOW() function.
